description: What the turn is about, decided before any rule is touched.

focus.description: 1-2 sentences: what the player is reaching for and what this turn is about.
focus.title: Focus

pressure.description: 1-2 sentences: what pushes back this turn — a complication, a cost, a threat. Empty when the turn is genuinely quiet and nothing should push back.
pressure.title: Pressure

stakes.description: One sentence: what the player stands to win or lose. Empty when nothing is at stake.
stakes.title: Stakes

threads.description: Ids of the active threads this turn serves; none when none apply.
threads.title: Threads

reveal.description: Ids of the things the player has not found yet that this turn should bring into play; none unless the fiction genuinely puts one in front of them.
reveal.title: Reveal
